_doc: PHASE 1 (OHLCV Truth Closure) PASS-A adversarial test matrix. E-MT-01-shaped: one failure class per OHLCV corruption/substitution mode, each with >=1 seeded defect and a detector probe. STATUS = PLANNED (frozen design; implementation is a later, separately-authorized step - PASS A implements nothing). expected_clean/expected_mutant define the red-green contract: the probe must PASS on clean data and FAIL when the seed is injected. Classes whose detector does not exist yet are marked PLANNED_NO_CURRENT_DETECTOR - these are honest coverage gaps, inputs to PASS B, not silent assumptions.
authority: PASS-A evidence artifact. Grants no closure, no economic claims, no implementation authority.
coverage_rule: Every failure class must have >=1 seed whose injection flips its detector probe from PASS to FAIL. Coverage COMPLETE is a PASS-B/E-MT prerequisite, not a PASS-A claim.
